title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends
summary: The securities have financed purchases of nearly 136,000 bitcoin, opening a funding channel that analysts expect to complement the larger ETF market.

title: Bitcoin’s wealthy holders turning to loans and yield as investment habits mature: Xapo CEO
summary: Borrowing against bitcoin and earning income to build their BTC holdings are becoming priorities for long-term investors, Xapo Bank CEO Seamus Rocca told CoinDesk.

title: Google Quietly Updates Privacy Policy to Let Gmail and Photos Data Feed Ads
summary: A policy change effective Oct. 16 carves out an exception to Google’s long-standing pledge—letting connected Gmail, Drive, and Photos data personalize ads through its Personal Intelligence AI features.

title: Sweden's Government Offices Block ChatGPT and Claude, Keep Microsoft Copilot
summary: Sweden's Government Offices will block ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers from Monday, steering civil servants to Microsoft Copilot as the only AI that passed its security review.

title: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
summary: Ahead of elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could turn to blockchain and crypto to skirt potential international sanctions, to the dismay of opponents and the country’s central banker.
